$comment: ANTI-DRIFT KEYSTONE. The single source of truth for how a slot's {font,size,align} becomes pixel geometry. The React live-preview reads this directly; the Python render generates ASS subtitles from the same numbers. Preview and export cannot diverge because they compute from one spec. Tested by the caption-parity test (web px == python ASS coords).
$comment_sizes: px = preview font-size at the prototype's phone scale (270px wide). canvas_px = render font-size at full 1080px canvas. ratio canvas/preview = 1080/270 = 4.0; canvas_px == px * 4 exactly. The parity test asserts this invariant.
$comment_ass: ass values are libass alignment codes for the BOTTOM row (1=bottom-left,2=bottom-center,3=bottom-right). The render adds +4 / +8 to move the anchor to middle/top rows as needed per layout.vertical.
